## Summary

Completes **Snapshot-to-Live W07 — Financial Limitation Resolution** on `ramkivs/iips-review-recovered` (`arena/e8f9f3d2-iips-review-recovered`), preserving all accepted **W05** dataset source-rights / coverage-qualification fixes (`6ae09ac0`) and Phase 1 identity hardening (`7f3f7db1`) atop `main` (`a835d4af`).

### W07 Limitation Dispositions (`docs/integration/W07-FINANCIAL-LIMITATION-RESOLUTION-2026-11-12.md`)

- **`L-038` (Marico Limited — consolidated `PREFERENCE_CAPITAL`):** **`UNRESOLVED_PENDING_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE`** *(IID historical register: `OPEN`)*
  - Audited FY24 (`03cb0db7...`), FY25 (`74e0f6c2...`), and FY26 (`7ea5e097...`) Integrated Annual Reports print `₹65 Crore` (`6,50,00,000` shares of ₹10 each, rounded to `"7 Crore"` shares) under *Authorised share capital* in Note 12(a), print only Equity Share Capital (`₹129 cr` FY24; `₹130 cr` FY25–FY26) under *Issued, subscribed and paid-up share capital*, use non-exhaustive `"includes::"` in Note 12(a)(v), and contain **no audited statement or note sentence declaring issued preference capital nil**.
  - Supplementary Companies Act filings (`Draft_MGT-7_-_FY24.pdf`, `Draft_MGT-7_-_FY25.pdf` on `marico.com`) tabulate `0` issued/subscribed/paid-up preference shares for standalone `MARICO LIMITED`, **but** are explicitly unsigned pre-AGM drafts (*"This is draft MGT-7 prepared before holding of AGM"*) and cover `STANDALONE_COMPANY` only rather than `CONSOLIDATED_GROUP` (21 subsidiaries including non-wholly-owned subsidiaries).
  - Absence of consolidated disclosure is never converted into `0`; `PREFERENCE_CAPITAL` remains `MISSING('NOT_REPORTED')` (`value: null`), withholding EV-to-equity per-share intrinsic value while keeping EV-only and price-free metrics intact.
- **`L-039` (KEC International Limited — consolidated `CURRENT_INVESTMENTS`):** **`UNRESOLVED_PENDING_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE`** *(IID historical register: `OPEN`)*
  - Verified SEBI's official `in-capmkt` taxonomy (`core/in-capmkt.xsd`, `in-capmkt-lab.xml`, `in-capmkt-cal-2025-01-31.xml`, `in-capmkt-ref-2025-01-31.xml` via NSE S.No. 6 and BSE S.No. 7): `in-capmkt:CurrentInvestments` (`instant`, `debit`, `nillable="true"`) references SEBI LODR Reg 33 Annexure IX and MCA Schedule III Part I Assets `(2)(b)(i)` and sums with weight `+1.0` into `CurrentFinancialAssets` (`₹19,390.60 cr` = `0 + 6,474.21 + 411.26 + 100.67 + 0 + 12,404.46` [Note 19 `276.90` + Note 20 Contract Assets `12,127.56`]).
  - Two independent blockers prevent treating `<CurrentInvestments decimals="-7">0</CurrentInvestments>` in `march-consolidated-xbrl.gz` as a verified zero: (1) SEBI/NSE/BSE publish only the `2025-01-31` taxonomy ZIP (`in-capmkt-ent-2025-01-31.xsd`), while the 2026 NSE Excel utility emits `in-capmkt-ent-2026-01-31.xsd` (`404` on NSE, `530` on `sebi.gov.in`); and (2) every zero monetary tag in `OneI` carries `decimals="-7"` (`₹1 cr` tolerance), **including `NoncurrentInvestments = 0` (`decimals="-7"`)** where audited Note 10 proves actual carrying value is **non-zero (`₹49,000` / `*-`)**.
  - `CURRENT_INVESTMENTS` remains `MISSING('NOT_REPORTED')` (`value: null`), withholding `NET_DEBT` and per-share intrinsic value while preserving `GROSS_DEBT` (`₹5,103.23 cr`), `ENTERPRISE_VALUE`, and price-free ratios.
- **`L-040` (`enterpriseToEquity` zero-substitution fix):** **`RESOLVED`** *(preserved intact; regression-verified)*.

### Narrow IRR XBRL Ingestion Corrections (`iips-platform/src/investment/ingestion/{xbrl.ts,builder.ts}`)

- **`W07-D1`:** Refuse zero-coercion on `xsi:nil="true"` and empty `""` XBRL facts (`EMPTY_OR_NIL_FACT` warning; stays `MISSING` `null` instead of `Number("") === 0`).
- **`W07-D2`:** Thread optional `periodStart` through `XbrlExtractionOptions` and `XbrlFileInput` so Q4 3-month duration contexts (`FourD`) no longer overwrite full-year 12-month duration contexts (`OneD`) sharing `periodEnd` on NSE `in-capmkt` filings.
- **`W07-D3`:** Flag and skip dimensional `<segment>` / `<scenario>` contexts (`explicitMember` / `typedMember`) when extracting undimensioned primary statement line items.
- **`W07-D4`:** Check `itemsPermittedBy(datasetSchema)` instead of hardcoded `!== 'IIPS_INVESTMENT_FUNDAMENTALS_V2'`, enabling `INVESTMENTS_IN_ASSOCIATES_AND_JOINT_VENTURES` under `CURRENT_DATASET_SCHEMA` (`V3`) while keeping `V1` refusal intact.
- **`W07-D5`:** Enforce `UNIT_NOT_INR` across both `INSTANT` and `DURATION` INR-denominated items.

## Verification

- Targeted W07 + L-038 + L-039 + L-040 + Ingestion + V2/V3 + NilBinding + W05 suites: **151 / 151 passed**
- `iips-platform`: `typecheck` (0 errors), `test` (**678 / 678 passed**), `test:iid` (**832 / 832 passed** across 198 suites)
- `frontend`: `typecheck`, `typecheck:investment-server`, `typecheck:replay-server` (0 errors), `test` (**199 files / 2,827 tests passed**), `build` (clean)

## W10 discovery handoff — INCOMPLETE

Commit `db098e2` publishes the preliminary 13-engine input inventory and `docs/integration/W10-HANDOFF-2026-11-12.md` for continuation. This is discovery evidence only: the complete field-level mapping matrix, integrated issuer qualification module, W10 regression tests, and post-implementation verification remain outstanding. No issuer has been qualified and W10 is not accepted.

**W10 — COMPLETE** (commit `b367589`).

Issuer-to-engine field mapping and qualification are implemented under `iips-platform/src/investment/qualification` (additive; no sector-engine, integration, W05 or W07 changes; A13 guard passes unchanged).

- **Mapping:** 192 declared inputs across all 13 certified engines, each with meaning, authorized source, status, transformation, period/basis/scope, units, missing/zero/invalid semantics, freshness, data quality, confidence and calibration implication; engine metadata mirrored from `CERTIFIED_ENGINES`. Published matrix is generated from the registry and pinned byte-for-byte by the suite.
- **Qualification:** `qualifyIssuerToEngines` evaluates all 13 engines per issuer, fails closed with field-level evidence and 30 machine-readable codes, consumes W07 capital structure unchanged (never substitutes net debt; refuses a debt instant that is not the pinned period), and publishes no score/verdict/recommendation.
- **Substantive finding:** 53 of 115 required inputs have an authorized source; 62 do not. Only Banking can qualify, and only when the caller explicitly enables its declared closing-balance ROA/ROE deviation. The other twelve engines refuse rather than being mapped from superficially similar fields — 62 required inputs are a methodology backlog for their owners.
- **Verification:** platform typecheck 0; `npm test` 678/678; `test:iid` 882/882 (832 + 50 W10); W07 9/9; frontend typechecks 0/0/0; frontend tests 2,827 pass + 1 skip; frontend build 0. GitHub CI: `Typecheck · Test · Build` success. Recorded in `docs/integration/W10-COMPLETION-2026-11-12.md`.

Nothing is merged; the PR is ready for review.

**W11 — implementation complete; acceptance NOT claimed** (commit `d10afbb`, CI `Typecheck · Test · Build` success).

Additive module `iips-platform/src/investment/execution/` (4 files, outside every A13-protected path; frozen engines/calibration/golden values, W05/W07/W08/W09/W10 and IPD unchanged):

- **Chain:** portfolio revision + read source + observed time → holding → W08-resolved security/issuer → W10 qualification at a pinned period → inputs built only from `RESOLVED` fields with per-field lineage → frozen certified engine via the existing certified dispatch adapter → digest-addressed reproducible record.
- **Fail-closed:** 19-code refusal vocabulary; identity unresolved/ambiguous/rejected, issuer or security absent from the dataset, security↔issuer mismatch, sector/engine mismatch, non-positive or mismatched revision, unpinned provenance, dataset-digest mismatch, and any unqualified or partially evidenced issuer all refuse with no score. Refusals carry no composite/verdict.
- **Actual evidence:** reading the real Infosys dataset and identity files through the verified fundamentals boundary, the governed resolver resolves `INE009A01021 → IN:CIN:L851KA1981PLC013115` (listing `IN:NSE:INFY:EQ:EQUITY`), and W10 refuses execution (11 blocking fields: 7 unauthorized, selector unresolved, 2 metrics absent). At a current date the same evidence is refused as stale.
- **Determinism:** repeated runs byte-identical; W11 output equals a direct certified-adapter call field-by-field.

**Blocked acceptance (not worked around):** (1) no reachable persisted owner portfolio — IPD owns the store, W03/W09 evidence; (2) actual identity coverage for a live revision (W04); (3) W10 authorizes 53/115 required inputs, so only Banking can qualify and no actual banking dataset exists here. The W10 62-input restriction is preserved intact.

Verification: platform typecheck 0; `npm test` 678/678 (golden + A13 guard); `test:iid` 913/913 (882 + 31 W11); W05+W10+W11 85/85; W07 9/9; frontend typechecks 0/0/0; frontend tests 2,827 pass + 1 skip; frontend build 0. No merge. Details: `docs/integration/W11-ISSUER-ENGINE-EXECUTION-2026-11-12.md`.

**Superseded by #568.**

This PR was not merged through its own merge button. Its seven commits (`7f3f7db`, `6ae09ac`, `7755db9`, `db098e2`, `b367589`, `d10afbb`, `8765860`) reached `main` unchanged through #568, merged on 2026-11-16T19:03:51Z as merge commit `064195397dfdb32bf0f34a461b02fd6b9f9a8df0`. GitHub then marked this PR as merged on its own (2026-11-16T19:03:53Z, shown against `90e6728`, the commit in #568's history that first joined this PR's head with `main`), so a separate close was not possible.

#568 carried this PR's work together with the merge of current `main`, the Windows named-pipe IPC correction `a20a972` and tracker §16.285 (`2baa9c2`).

Record of this PR, preserved:

- Head `8765860`; 7 commits; 50 files, +11,780 / −97; base `main`.
- `CI / Typecheck · Test · Build`: success at `8765860` on 2026-11-14T06:27:24Z.
- The owner comments of 2026-11-12T21:02:28Z (W10 complete, `b367589`) and 2026-11-13T04:16:47Z (W11 implementation complete, acceptance not claimed, `d10afbb`) remain above. No reviews.
- The head branch `arena/e8f9f3d2-iips-review-recovered` is kept at `8765860`.

Nothing in this PR is withdrawn. On the merged result, `CI` and the CAP-03 static check passed on #568's head `7f53974` and on `main` at `0641953`.
